overall_intent: The requester wants three independently chosen concepts that test the newly integrated idol-fiction topic and use the supplied image. This arm independently selected music-show rehearsal with OS randomness. My invented scene follows a fictional 24-year-old idol returning to her stage mark under the floor manager count-in, with two fellow performers making the coordination visible. The intended experience is poised appeal inside real collective work: her face matters, but production context should keep the image from becoming a detached beauty portrait. Reference use concerns visible face and hair appearance only. The performer age, rehearsal, crew, group, stage clothes, mark and camera are replaceable authorial staging, not requester facts. At creativity 1 local refinements may strengthen connected attention and rehearsal clarity without changing the broad direction.
